recognize_zh: 這是兩張 Kaplan-Meier 存活曲線圖（非形態學影像）：A 為 FCR 前處置後 OS 78%、PFS 72%，B 為 YFC 前處置後 OS 88%、PFS 74%，曲線在移植後早期下降後呈長期平台；圖內前處置為非清髓性異體移植方案，與標題所寫的自體移植不完全一致。
features: Two Kaplan-Meier plots of cumulative proportion surviving versus months post transplant
Panel A (FCR regimen): OS 78% and PFS 72% with follow-up to about 140 months
Panel B (YFC regimen): OS 88% and PFS 74% with follow-up to about 90 months
Early drop within the first year followed by a sustained plateau, with tick marks for censored patients
Small cohorts suggested by stepwise curves
describe_en: This non-morphologic figure shows Kaplan-Meier estimates of overall and progression-free survival after transplantation for follicular lymphoma. Panel A shows outcomes after FCR (fludarabine, cyclophosphamide, rituximab) conditioning, with OS of 78% and PFS of 72% at long-term follow-up, and panel B shows outcomes after YFC (90Y-ibritumomab tiuxetan with fludarabine and cyclophosphamide), with OS of 88% and PFS of 74%. Both curves show early events followed by a durable plateau, supporting a curative graft-versus-lymphoma effect. Note that FCR and YFC are reduced-intensity allogeneic conditioning regimens, so the figure actually depicts nonmyeloablative allogeneic rather than autologous transplantation as stated in the title.
